items.title: Curtis Mitchell Interview, 1996-04-02
items.q: See I knew all his brothers... His brothers, there's a brother named Edgar White, Joseph, well Danny's name was Joseph... They're from my neighborhood too

ctx.x: Yeah, I mean I know Danny White.

Well his brothers used to have a quartet. See I knew all his brothers. Oh Danny's brothers. His brothers, they used to have called the White Brothers, you know. White Brothers. Yeah. And then, well see Danny was smaller than them, you know. Danny wasn't in the quartet, his brothers was older, you know. The White Brothers. His brothers, there's a brother named Edgar White, Joseph, well Danny's name was Joseph. Yeah. Arthur White, you know. They had a quartet. They're from my neighborhood too, you know.
They're from around there? Yeah. The Leonidas.
